The 2019 Incentive Plan authorized the issuance of 17,500,000 shares (10,000,000 RSUs) of common stock for future grants, plus the
remaining shares that were available for grant and the future forfeited shares from grants under the previous plan, up to a maximum aggregate
of 27,800,000 shares (15,885,000 RSUs). The Company issues new shares of common stock upon vesting of RSUs. Shares for vested RSUs
are generally delivered to participants annually, net of shares withheld for taxes.
As required by the 2019 Incentive Plan, in conjunction with the 2024 special dividend, the number of shares subject to outstanding RSUs was
increased on the dividend record date to preserve their value. They were adjusted by multiplying the number of outstanding shares by a factor of
1.018, representing the ratio of the Nasdaq closing price of $674.62 on December 26, 2023, which was the last trading day immediately prior to
the ex-dividend date, to the Nasdaq opening price of $662.70 on the ex-dividend date, December 27, 2023. The outstanding RSUs increased by
approximately 52,000. The adjustment did not result in additional stock-based compensation expense, as the fair value of the awards did not
change. As further required by the 2019 Incentive Plan, the maximum number of shares issuable under the plan was proportionally adjusted,
which resulted in an additional 128,000 RSU shares available to be granted.
Summary of Restricted Stock Unit Activity
At the end of 2024, 7,278,000 shares were available to be granted as RSUs, and the following awards, adjusted for the effects of the special
dividend, were outstanding:
• 2,677,000 time-based RSUs, which vest upon continued employment or service over specified periods of time; and
• 122,000 performance-based RSUs, of which 95,000 were granted to executive officers subject to the determination of the attainment of
performance targets for 2024, which occurred in September 2024. At that time, depending upon long-service terms, at least 33% of the
units vested. The remaining awards vest upon continued employment over specified periods of time. Please refer to Note 1 for
accelerated vesting requirements.

The Company maintains various short-term bank credit facilities, with a borrowing capacity of $1,198 and $1,234, in 2024 and 2023. Short-term
borrowings outstanding were immaterial at the end of 2024 and 2023.
Long-Term Debt
The Company's long-term debt consists primarily of Senior Notes, described below. The Company at its option may redeem the Senior Notes at
any time, in whole or in part, at a redemption price plus accrued interest. The redemption price is equal to the greater of 100% of the principal
amount or the sum of the present value of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest to maturity. Additionally, upon certain
events, a holder has the right to require a repurchase at a price of 101% of the principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest. Interest on all
outstanding long-term debt is payable semi-annually. The estimated fair value of Senior Notes is valued using Level 2 inputs.
Other long-term debt consists of Guaranteed Senior Notes issued by the Company's Japanese subsidiary, valued using Level 3 inputs. In
November 2023, the Company’s Japan subsidiary issued four Guaranteed Senior Notes, totaling approximately $500, at fixed interest rates
ranging from 1.400% to 2.120%. Interest is payable semi-annually, and maturity dates range from November 7, 2033, to November 7, 2043. In
July 2024, the Japanese subsidiary repaid $77 of its Guaranteed Senior Notes.
On May 18, 2024, the Company paid the $1,000 outstanding principal balance and interest on the 2.750% Senior Notes using cash and cash
equivalents and short-term investments.

Our members may utilize their memberships at all of our warehouses and e-commerce sites. Gold Star memberships are available to individuals;
Business memberships are limited to businesses, including individuals with a business license, retail sales license, or comparable document.
Business members may add additional cardholders (affiliates), to which the same annual fee applies. Affiliates are not available for Gold Star
members. During fiscal 2024, our annual fee for these memberships was $60 in the U.S. and varies in other countries. All paid memberships
include a free household card.
Paid members (except affiliates) were eligible to upgrade to an Executive membership in the U.S., for an additional annual fee of $60. Executive
memberships are also available in Canada, Mexico, the U.K., Japan, Korea, Taiwan, and Australia, for which the additional fee varies. Executive
members earn a 2% reward on qualified purchases (generally up to a maximum reward of $1,000 per year), redeemable at Costco warehouses.
The sales penetration of Executive members represented approximately 73.3% of worldwide net sales in 2024.
Our member renewal rate was 92.9% in the U.S. and Canada and 90.5% worldwide at the end of 2024. The majority of members renew within
six months following their renewal date. Our renewal rate, which excludes affiliates of Business members, is a trailing calculation that captures
renewals during the period seven to eighteen months prior to the reporting date. Our membership counts include active memberships as well as
memberships that have not renewed within the 12 months prior to the reporting date.

**Gross Profit** is calculated as:
\[ \text{Total Revenue} - \text{Merchandise Costs} \]

So for fiscal year 2024:

\[ \$254,453 - \$222,358 = \$32,095 \text{ million} \]

Therefore, the Gross Profit in the year ending 2024 is **$32,095 million**.

To calculate the unadjusted EBITDA for Costco Wholesale Corporation for the year ending September 1, 2024:

1. Start with operating income: $9,285 million.
2. Add back depreciation and amortization expense (found under cash flows from operating activities): $2,237 million.

\[ \text{EBITDA} = \text{Operating Income} + \text{Depreciation and Amortization} \]
\[ \text{EBITDA} = 9,285 + 2,237 = 11,522 \]

Therefore, the unadjusted EBITDA for Costco Wholesale Corporation for the year ending September 1, 2024 is **$11,522 million**.

To compute the unadjusted EBITDA Margin for Costco Wholesale Corporation for the year ended September 1, 2024:

1. **EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization)**:
   - Start with Operating Income: $9,285 million.
   - Add back Depreciation and amortization expense from the cash flow statement: $2,237 million.

   \[
   \text{EBITDA} = \$9,285 + \$2,237 = \$11,522 \text{ million}
   \]

2. **Total Revenue**:
   - Total revenue for the period is provided as $254,453 million.

3. **Unadjusted EBITDA Margin**:
   - The formula to calculate the margin is:

     \[
     \text{EBITDA Margin} = \left( \frac{\text{EBITDA}}{\text{Total Revenue}} \right) \times 100
     \]

   - Plugging in the numbers:

     \[
     \text{EBITDA Margin} = \left( \frac{\$11,522}{\$254,453} \right) \times 100 \approx 4.53\%
     \]

Therefore, the unadjusted EBITDA Margin for Costco Wholesale Corporation for 2024 is approximately **4.53%**.

To calculate the Operating Profit Margin for Costco Wholesale Corporation for the year ending September 1, 2024:

1. **Operating Income**: $9,285 million (from the Consolidated Statements of Income)
2. **Total Revenue**: $254,453 million (Net Sales + Membership fees)

The formula to calculate Operating Profit Margin is:
\[ \text{Operating Profit Margin} = \left( \frac{\text{Operating Income}}{\text{Total Revenue}} \right) \times 100 \]

Plugging in the values from the financial statements:
\[ \text{Operating Profit Margin} = \left( \frac{9,285}{254,453} \right) \times 100 \approx 3.65\% \]

Therefore, the Operating Profit Margin for Costco Wholesale Corporation in the year ending September 1, 2024 is approximately **3.65%**.

To determine if the Operating Profit Margin is greater in 2024 compared to 2023, we need to calculate it for both years using the provided financial data.

**Operating Income:**
- 2024: $9,285 million
- 2023: $8,114 million

**Total Revenue:**
- 2024: $254,453 million
- 2023: $242,290 million

Now, calculate the Operating Profit Margin for each year:

\[
\text{Operating Profit Margin} = \left( \frac{\text{Operating Income}}{\text{Total Revenue}} \right) \times 100
\]

For **2024**:
\[
\text{Operating Profit Margin} = \left( \frac{9,285}{254,453} \right) \times 100 \approx 3.65\%
\]

For **2023**:
\[
\text{Operating Profit Margin} = \left( \frac{8,114}{242,290} \right) \times 100 \approx 3.35\%
\]

Comparing the two margins:
- 2024: 3.65%
- 2023: 3.35%

Therefore, the Operating Profit Margin is greater in **2024** compared to **2023**.

remaining shares that were available for grant and the future forfeited shares from grants under the previous plan, up to a maximum aggregate
of 27,800,000 shares (15,885,000 RSUs). The Company issues new shares of common stock upon vesting of RSUs. Shares for vested RSUs
are generally delivered to participants annually, net of shares withheld for taxes.
As required by the 2019 Incentive Plan, in conjunction with the 2024 special dividend, the number of shares subject to outstanding RSUs was
increased on the dividend record date to preserve their value. They were adjusted by multiplying the number of outstanding shares by a factor of
1.018, representing the ratio of the Nasdaq closing price of $674.62 on December 26, 2023, which was the last trading day immediately prior to
the ex-dividend date, to the Nasdaq opening price of $662.70 on the ex-dividend date, December 27, 2023. The outstanding RSUs increased by
approximately 52,000. The adjustment did not result in additional stock-based compensation expense, as the fair value of the awards did not
change. As further required by the 2019 Incentive Plan, the maximum number of shares issuable under the plan was proportionally adjusted,
which resulted in an additional 128,000 RSU shares available to be granted.

The Company's long-term debt consists primarily of Senior Notes, described below. The Company at its option may redeem the Senior Notes at
any time, in whole or in part, at a redemption price plus accrued interest. The redemption price is equal to the greater of 100% of the principal
amount or the sum of the present value of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest to maturity. Additionally, upon certain
events, a holder has the right to require a repurchase at a price of 101% of the principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest. Interest on all
outstanding long-term debt is payable semi-annually. The estimated fair value of Senior Notes is valued using Level 2 inputs.

November 2023, the Company’s Japan subsidiary issued four Guaranteed Senior Notes, totaling approximately $500, at fixed interest rates

remaining shares that were available for grant and the future forfeited shares from grants under the previous plan, up to a maximum aggregate

are generally delivered to participants annually, net of shares withheld for taxes.
As required by the 2019 Incentive Plan, in conjunction with the 2024 special dividend, the number of shares subject to outstanding RSUs was
increased on the dividend record date to preserve their value. They were adjusted by multiplying the number of outstanding shares by a factor of
1.018, representing the ratio of the Nasdaq closing price of $674.62 on December 26, 2023, which was the last trading day immediately prior to
the ex-dividend date, to the Nasdaq opening price of $662.70 on the ex-dividend date, December 27, 2023. The outstanding RSUs increased by
approximately 52,000. The adjustment did not result in additional stock-based compensation expense, as the fair value of the awards did not
change. As further required by the 2019 Incentive Plan, the maximum number of shares issuable under the plan was proportionally adjusted,
which resulted in an additional 128,000 RSU shares available to be granted.

Long-Term Debt
The Company's long-term debt consists primarily of Senior Notes, described below. The Company at its option may redeem the Senior Notes at
any time, in whole or in part, at a redemption price plus accrued interest. The redemption price is equal to the greater of 100% of the principal
amount or the sum of the present value of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest to maturity. Additionally, upon certain
events, a holder has the right to require a repurchase at a price of 101% of the principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest. Interest on all
outstanding long-term debt is payable semi-annually. The estimated fair value of Senior Notes is valued using Level 2 inputs.
Other long-term debt consists of Guaranteed Senior Notes issued by the Company's Japanese subsidiary, valued using Level 3 inputs. In
November 2023, the Company’s Japan subsidiary issued four Guaranteed Senior Notes, totaling approximately $500, at fixed interest rates
ranging from 1.400% to 2.120%. Interest is payable semi-annually, and maturity dates range from November 7, 2033, to November 7, 2043. In
July 2024, the Japanese subsidiary repaid $77 of its Guaranteed Senior Notes.

the impact of one less week of sales in 2024. Lower gasoline prices negatively impacted net sales by $917, or 39 basis points, compared to
2023, with a 3% decrease in the average price per gallon. Changes in foreign currencies relative to the U.S. dollar negatively impacted net sales
by approximately $474, 20 basis points, compared to 2023, attributable to our Canadian and Other International operations.

Comparable sales increased 5% during 2024 and were positively impacted by an increase in shopping frequency, partially offset by a slight
decrease in average ticket.

To calculate the P/E ratio for Costco Wholesale Corporation as of September 1, 2024, using diluted earnings per share (EPS), we need to follow these steps:

1. **Identify Net Income**: The net income attributable to Costco is $7,367 million.

\[ \text{P/E Ratio} = \frac{\text{Stock Price}}{\text{Earnings Per Share (EPS)}} \]

Given:
- Stock price as of September 1, 2024: $940
- Diluted EPS for the year ended September 1, 2024: $16.56

Substituting these values into the formula gives:
\[ \text{P/E Ratio} = \frac{940}{16.56} \approx 56.78 \]

Therefore, the P/E ratio for Costco Wholesale Corporation as of September 1, 2024, using diluted EPS is approximately **56.78**.

### Diluted EPS of Costco

The diluted earnings per share (EPS) for Costco as reported in the financial statements is:
- For the year ending September 1, 2024: **$16.56**

### Manually Calculating Fully Diluted Shares Outstanding

To manually calculate the fully diluted shares outstanding for Costco as of September 1, 2024, we can use the following formula:

\[ \text{Diluted EPS} = \frac{\text{Net Income}}{\text{Diluted Shares Outstanding}} \]

Given:
- Net Income (attributable to Costco) as of September 1, 2024: **$7,367 million**
- Diluted EPS as of September 1, 2024: **$16.56**

Rearranging the formula to solve for diluted shares outstanding:

\[ \text{Diluted Shares Outstanding} = \frac{\text{Net Income}}{\text{Diluted EPS}} \]

Substituting in the given values:

\[ \text{Diluted Shares Outstanding} = \frac{7,367}{16.56} \approx 445,082,739 \text{ shares} \]

However, Costco reports diluted shares outstanding as:
- For the year ending September 1, 2024: **444,759 thousand** or approximately **444,759,000 shares**

This slight discrepancy can be attributed to rounding and other adjustments that are not explicitly detailed in the provided context. The reported value of **444,759,000 shares** is consistent with Costco's financial reporting for diluted EPS calculation purposes.

So, the fully diluted shares outstanding as of September 1, 2024, is approximately **444,759,000 shares**.

To estimate the cost of equity using the Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) for Costco Wholesale Corporation in 2024, we use the following formula:

\[
\text{Cost of Equity} = R_f + \beta(R_m - R_f)
\]

Where:
- \(R_f\) is the risk-free rate.
- \(\beta\) is the beta of the stock.
- \(R_m\) is the expected market return.

Given:
- Beta (\(\beta\)) for Costco: 0.79
- Risk-Free Rate (\(R_f\)): The 10-year Treasury yield, which is 4.617%
- Market Return (\(R_m\)): 11%

Plugging in the values:

\[
\text{Cost of Equity} = 4.617\% + (0.79 \times (11\% - 4.617\%))
\]

Calculating inside the parentheses first:

\[
11\% - 4.617\% = 6.383\%
\]

Next, multiply by beta:

\[
0.79 \times 6.383\% = 5.04157\%
\]

Finally, add the risk-free rate:

\[
4.617\% + 5.04157\% = 9.65857\%
\]

Rounded to two decimal places, the estimated cost of equity for Costco Wholesale Corporation in 2024 using the CAPM model is approximately **9.66%**.

amount or the sum of the present value of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest to maturity. Additionally, upon certain
events, a holder has the right to require a repurchase at a price of 101% of the principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest. Interest on all
outstanding long-term debt is payable semi-annually. The estimated fair value of Senior Notes is valued using Level 2 inputs.

The 2019 Incentive Plan authorized the issuance of 17,500,000 shares (10,000,000 RSUs) of common stock for future grants, plus the
remaining shares that were available for grant and the future forfeited shares from grants under the previous plan, up to a maximum aggregate
of 27,800,000 shares (15,885,000 RSUs). The Company issues new shares of common stock upon vesting of RSUs. Shares for vested RSUs
are generally delivered to participants annually, net of shares withheld for taxes.
As required by the 2019 Incentive Plan, in conjunction with the 2024 special dividend, the number of shares subject to outstanding RSUs was
increased on the dividend record date to preserve their value. They were adjusted by multiplying the number of outstanding shares by a factor of
1.018, representing the ratio of the Nasdaq closing price of $674.62 on December 26, 2023, which was the last trading day immediately prior to
the ex-dividend date, to the Nasdaq opening price of $662.70 on the ex-dividend date, December 27, 2023. The outstanding RSUs increased by
approximately 52,000. The adjustment did not result in additional stock-based compensation expense, as the fair value of the awards did not
change. As further required by the 2019 Incentive Plan, the maximum number of shares issuable under the plan was proportionally adjusted,
which resulted in an additional 128,000 RSU shares available to be granted.

Long-Term Debt
The Company's long-term debt consists primarily of Senior Notes, described below. The Company at its option may redeem the Senior Notes at
any time, in whole or in part, at a redemption price plus accrued interest. The redemption price is equal to the greater of 100% of the principal
amount or the sum of the present value of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest to maturity. Additionally, upon certain
events, a holder has the right to require a repurchase at a price of 101% of the principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest. Interest on all
outstanding long-term debt is payable semi-annually. The estimated fair value of Senior Notes is valued using Level 2 inputs.
Other long-term debt consists of Guaranteed Senior Notes issued by the Company's Japanese subsidiary, valued using Level 3 inputs. In
November 2023, the Company’s Japan subsidiary issued four Guaranteed Senior Notes, totaling approximately $500, at fixed interest rates
ranging from 1.400% to 2.120%. Interest is payable semi-annually, and maturity dates range from November 7, 2033, to November 7, 2043. In
July 2024, the Japanese subsidiary repaid $77 of its Guaranteed Senior Notes.

To calculate the **Operating Deferred Tax Asset, net of deferred tax liabilities** for Costco Wholesale Corporation as of September 3, 2023:

1. **Identify Net Deferred Tax Assets:**
   - From the consolidated financial statements provided:
     \[
     \text{Total deferred tax assets} = \$2,107
     \]
     \[
     \text{Valuation allowance} = \$422
     \]
     \[
     \text{Net deferred tax assets} = \text{Total deferred tax assets} - \text{Valuation allowance}
     \]
     \[
     \text{Net deferred tax assets} = \$2,107 - \$422 = \$1,685
     \]

2. **Identify Net Deferred Tax Liabilities:**
   - From the consolidated financial statements provided:
     \[
     \text{Total deferred tax liabilities} = \$1,989
     \]
   
3. **Calculate Operating Deferred Tax Asset, net of deferred tax liabilities:**
   \[
   \text{Operating Deferred Tax Asset, net of deferred tax liabilities} = \text{Net deferred tax assets} - \text{Total deferred tax liabilities}
   \]
   \[
   \text{Operating Deferred Tax Asset, net of deferred tax liabilities} = \$1,685 - \$1,989 = -\$304
   \]

Therefore, the Operating Deferred Tax Asset, net of deferred tax liabilities for Costco Wholesale Corporation as of September 3, 2023 is **-\$304 million**.

Long-Term Debt
The Company's long-term debt consists primarily of Senior Notes, described below. The Company at its option may redeem the Senior Notes at
any time, in whole or in part, at a redemption price plus accrued interest. The redemption price is equal to the greater of 100% of the principal
amount or the sum of the present value of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest to maturity. Additionally, upon certain
events, a holder has the right to require a repurchase at a price of 101% of the principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest. Interest on all
outstanding long-term debt is payable semi-annually. The estimated fair value of Senior Notes is valued using Level 2 inputs.
Other long-term debt consists of Guaranteed Senior Notes issued by the Company's Japanese subsidiary, valued using Level 3 inputs. In

Net sales increased $11,915 or 5% during 2024. The improvement was attributable to an increase in comparable sales and sales at new
warehouses opened in 2023 and 2024, partially offset by the impact of one less week of sales in 2024. Sales increased $10,639, or 6% in core
merchandise categories, increasing in all categories. Sales increased $1,276, or 3% in warehouse ancillary and other businesses, led by
pharmacy, partially offset by a decrease in gasoline.
During 2024, the volume of gasoline sold increased approximately 1%, positively impacting net sales by $400, or 17 basis points, which includes
the impact of one less week of sales in 2024. Lower gasoline prices negatively impacted net sales by $917, or 39 basis points, compared to
2023, with a 3% decrease in the average price per gallon. Changes in foreign currencies relative to the U.S. dollar negatively impacted net sales
by approximately $474, 20 basis points, compared to 2023, attributable to our Canadian and Other International operations.

remaining shares that were available for grant and the future forfeited shares from grants under the previous plan, up to a maximum aggregate

are generally delivered to participants annually, net of shares withheld for taxes.
As required by the 2019 Incentive Plan, in conjunction with the 2024 special dividend, the number of shares subject to outstanding RSUs was
increased on the dividend record date to preserve their value. They were adjusted by multiplying the number of outstanding shares by a factor of
1.018, representing the ratio of the Nasdaq closing price of $674.62 on December 26, 2023, which was the last trading day immediately prior to
the ex-dividend date, to the Nasdaq opening price of $662.70 on the ex-dividend date, December 27, 2023. The outstanding RSUs increased by
approximately 52,000. The adjustment did not result in additional stock-based compensation expense, as the fair value of the awards did not
change. As further required by the 2019 Incentive Plan, the maximum number of shares issuable under the plan was proportionally adjusted,
which resulted in an additional 128,000 RSU shares available to be granted.

To determine the excess cash for Costco Wholesale Corporation as of September 1, 2024:

### Step-by-Step Calculation:
1. **Operating Cash Calculation:**
   - Calculate 2% of total revenue: \( 2\% \times \$254,453 = \$5,089.06 \)
   - Compare the calculated amount to cash and cash equivalents (\$9,906).
   - Operating cash is the minimum between these two figures: \( \min(\$5,089.06, \$9,906) = \$5,089.06 \)

2. **Excess Cash Calculation:**
   - Excess cash is defined as total cash and cash equivalents minus operating cash.
   - Total cash and cash equivalents (Cash and cash equivalents): \$9,906
   - Operating cash: \$5,089.06

\[ \text{Excess Cash} = \$9,906 - \$5,089.06 = \$4,816.94 \]

### Conclusion:
The excess cash for Costco Wholesale Corporation as of September 1, 2024 is **\$4,816.94 million**.

To calculate the Return on Equity (ROE) for Costco Wholesale Corporation for the fiscal year ending September 1, 2024:

\[ \text{ROE} = \frac{\text{Net Income Attributable to Costco}}{\text{Average Shareholders' Equity}} \]

From the provided financial statements:
- Net income attributable to Costco in 2024: $7,367 million
- Total equity (shareholders’ equity) at the end of 2024: $23,622 million
- Total equity at the end of 2023: $25,058 million

First, calculate the average shareholders' equity:
\[ \text{Average Shareholders' Equity} = \frac{\text{Equity in 2024} + \text{Equity in 2023}}{2} = \frac{23,622 + 25,058}{2} = 24,340 \]

Now calculate the ROE:
\[ \text{ROE} = \frac{7,367}{24,340} \approx 0.3027 \]

Convert to percentage form:
\[ \text{ROE} = 0.3027 \times 100 \approx 30.27\% \]

So, the ROE for Costco Wholesale Corporation for fiscal year 2024 is approximately **30.27%**.

The 2019 Incentive Plan authorized the issuance of 17,500,000 shares (10,000,000 RSUs) of common stock for future grants, plus the
remaining shares that were available for grant and the future forfeited shares from grants under the previous plan, up to a maximum aggregate
of 27,800,000 shares (15,885,000 RSUs). The Company issues new shares of common stock upon vesting of RSUs. Shares for vested RSUs
are generally delivered to participants annually, net of shares withheld for taxes.
As required by the 2019 Incentive Plan, in conjunction with the 2024 special dividend, the number of shares subject to outstanding RSUs was
increased on the dividend record date to preserve their value. They were adjusted by multiplying the number of outstanding shares by a factor of
1.018, representing the ratio of the Nasdaq closing price of $674.62 on December 26, 2023, which was the last trading day immediately prior to
the ex-dividend date, to the Nasdaq opening price of $662.70 on the ex-dividend date, December 27, 2023. The outstanding RSUs increased by
approximately 52,000. The adjustment did not result in additional stock-based compensation expense, as the fair value of the awards did not
change. As further required by the 2019 Incentive Plan, the maximum number of shares issuable under the plan was proportionally adjusted,
which resulted in an additional 128,000 RSU shares available to be granted.

Long-Term Debt
The Company's long-term debt consists primarily of Senior Notes, described below. The Company at its option may redeem the Senior Notes at
any time, in whole or in part, at a redemption price plus accrued interest. The redemption price is equal to the greater of 100% of the principal
amount or the sum of the present value of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest to maturity. Additionally, upon certain
events, a holder has the right to require a repurchase at a price of 101% of the principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest. Interest on all
outstanding long-term debt is payable semi-annually. The estimated fair value of Senior Notes is valued using Level 2 inputs.
Other long-term debt consists of Guaranteed Senior Notes issued by the Company's Japanese subsidiary, valued using Level 3 inputs. In
November 2023, the Company’s Japan subsidiary issued four Guaranteed Senior Notes, totaling approximately $500, at fixed interest rates
ranging from 1.400% to 2.120%. Interest is payable semi-annually, and maturity dates range from November 7, 2033, to November 7, 2043. In
July 2024, the Japanese subsidiary repaid $77 of its Guaranteed Senior Notes.
On May 18, 2024, the Company paid the $1,000 outstanding principal balance and interest on the 2.750% Senior Notes using cash and cash
equivalents and short-term investments.

renewals during the period seven to eighteen months prior to the reporting date. Our membership counts include active memberships as well as
memberships that have not renewed within the 12 months prior to the reporting date.

reviews goodwill annually in the fourth quarter for impairment or when circumstances indicate carrying value may exceed the fair value. This

approach estimates fair value based on expected discounted future cash flows, while the market approach uses comparable public companies

by approximately $474, 20 basis points, compared to 2023, attributable to our Canadian and Other International operations.

\[ \text{ARPU} = \frac{\text{Total Revenue}}{\text{Number of Paid Members}} \]

Substituting the given values into the formula:

\[ \text{ARPU} = \frac{254,453}{76.2} \approx 3339.18 \]

Therefore, the ARPU for Costco Wholesale Corporation in 2024 is approximately $3,339.18 per user.

To calculate the levered free cash flow (LFCF) for Costco Wholesale Corporation as of September 1, 2024, we need to follow these steps:

1. **Start with Operating Cash Flow**: The operating cash flow is given as $11,339 million.
   
2. **Subtract Capital Expenditures (CapEx)**: CapEx includes the addition to property and equipment. This amount can be found in the statement of cash flows under "Additions to property and equipment," which is $4,710 million for 2024.

3. **Calculate Levered Free Cash Flow**:
   \[
   LFCF = \text{Operating Cash Flow} - \text{Capital Expenditures}
   \]
   \[
   LFCF = \$11,339 - \$4,710
   \]
   \[
   LFCF = \$6,629 \text{ million}
   \]

Thus, the levered free cash flow for Costco Wholesale Corporation as of September 1, 2024, is $6,629 million.

To calculate the Accounts Receivables Days for Costco Wholesale Corporation as of September 1, 2024:

**Formula:**
\[ \text{Accounts Receivables Days} = \left( \frac{\text{Average Receivables}}{\text{Net Sales per Day}} \right) \times 365 \]

**Step-by-Step Calculation:**

1. **Determine the average receivables for 2024 and 2023:**
   - Receivables, net as of September 1, 2024 = $2,721 million
   - Receivables, net as of September 3, 2023 = $2,285 million

\[ \text{Average Receivables} = \frac{(2,721 + 2,285)}{2} = \frac{4,006}{2} = 2,003 \text{ million} \]

2. **Calculate the net sales per day for 2024:**
   - Net Sales in 2024 (52 weeks) = $249,625 million
   - Number of days in 2024 = 365

\[ \text{Net Sales per Day} = \frac{249,625}{365} \approx 683.85 \text{ million/day} \]

3. **Calculate the Accounts Receivables Days:**

\[ \text{Accounts Receivables Days} = \left( \frac{2,003}{683.85} \right) \times 365 \approx 1094.57 / 683.85 \times 365 \approx 585.28 / 683.85 \approx 3.08 \]

Therefore, the Accounts Receivables Days for Costco Wholesale Corporation as of September 1, 2024 is approximately **3.08 days**.

To calculate the Accounts Payables Days for Costco Wholesale Corporation as of September 1, 2024:

1. **Accounts Payable**: $19,421 million (from the Consolidated Balance Sheets)
2. **Merchandise Costs** (COGS): $222,358 million (from the Consolidated Statements of Income for 2024)

The formula to calculate Accounts Payables Days is:
\[ \text{Accounts Payables Days} = \left( \frac{\text{Accounts Payable}}{\text{Merchandise Costs}} \right) \times 365 \]

Plugging in the values:
\[ \text{Accounts Payables Days} = \left( \frac{19,421}{222,358} \right) \times 365 \]
\[ \text{Accounts Payables Days} = (0.0874) \times 365 \]
\[ \text{Accounts Payables Days} = 31.81 \]

Therefore, the Accounts Payables Days for Costco Wholesale Corporation as of September 1, 2024 is approximately **31.81 days**.

To calculate the Inventory Turnover for Costco Wholesale Corporation for 2024:

1. **Identify Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)**: From the income statement, COGS is represented as "Merchandise costs," which was $222,358 million.
   
2. **Determine Average Inventory**: 
   - Merchandise inventories at the end of 2024 were $18,647 million.
   - Merchandise inventories at the end of 2023 were $16,651 million.

\[ \text{Average Inventory} = \frac{(18,647 + 16,651)}{2} = \frac{35,298}{2} = 17,649 \]

3. **Calculate Inventory Turnover**:
   
\[ \text{Inventory Turnover} = \frac{\text{COGS}}{\text{Average Inventory}} = \frac{222,358}{17,649} ≈ 12.55 \]

So, the inventory turnover for Costco Wholesale Corporation in 2024 is approximately **12.55** times per year.

To calculate the Asset Turnover ratio for Costco Wholesale Corporation for the fiscal year ending September 1, 2024:

**Formula:**
\[ \text{Asset Turnover} = \frac{\text{Total Revenue}}{\text{Average Total Assets}} \]

**Step-by-step Calculation:**

1. **Total Revenue for 2024:** $254,453 million (from the consolidated statements of income)
   
2. **Total Assets as of September 1, 2024:** $69,831 million
   - Total Assets as of September 3, 2023: $68,994 million

3. **Calculate Average Total Assets for the year ending September 1, 2024:**
\[ \text{Average Total Assets} = \frac{\text{Total Assets (end of 2024)} + \text{Total Assets (end of 2023)}}{2} \]
\[ \text{Average Total Assets} = \frac{69,831 + 68,994}{2} \]
\[ \text{Average Total Assets} = \frac{138,825}{2} \]
\[ \text{Average Total Assets} = 69,412.5 \]

4. **Asset Turnover Ratio:**
\[ \text{Asset Turnover} = \frac{\text{Total Revenue}}{\text{Average Total Assets}} \]
\[ \text{Asset Turnover} = \frac{254,453}{69,412.5} \]
\[ \text{Asset Turnover} \approx 3.67 \]

Therefore, the Asset Turnover ratio for Costco Wholesale Corporation for the fiscal year ending September 1, 2024 is approximately **3.67**.

amount or the sum of the present value of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest to maturity. Additionally, upon certain
events, a holder has the right to require a repurchase at a price of 101% of the principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest. Interest on all

To calculate the **Sales per store** for Costco Wholesale Corporation in 2024:

1. Identify the total net sales from the financial statements: $249,625 million.
2. Determine the number of stores operating at the end of 2024 (from Item 2—Properties): 890 warehouses.

\[ \text{Sales per store} = \frac{\text{Total Net Sales}}{\text{Number of Stores}} \]

\[ \text{Sales per store} = \frac{249,625}{890} \approx \$279.92 \text{ million} \]

So, the sales per store in 2024 were approximately **$279.92 million**.

The 2019 Incentive Plan authorized the issuance of 17,500,000 shares (10,000,000 RSUs) of common stock for future grants, plus the
remaining shares that were available for grant and the future forfeited shares from grants under the previous plan, up to a maximum aggregate
of 27,800,000 shares (15,885,000 RSUs). The Company issues new shares of common stock upon vesting of RSUs. Shares for vested RSUs
are generally delivered to participants annually, net of shares withheld for taxes.
As required by the 2019 Incentive Plan, in conjunction with the 2024 special dividend, the number of shares subject to outstanding RSUs was
increased on the dividend record date to preserve their value. They were adjusted by multiplying the number of outstanding shares by a factor of
1.018, representing the ratio of the Nasdaq closing price of $674.62 on December 26, 2023, which was the last trading day immediately prior to
the ex-dividend date, to the Nasdaq opening price of $662.70 on the ex-dividend date, December 27, 2023. The outstanding RSUs increased by
approximately 52,000. The adjustment did not result in additional stock-based compensation expense, as the fair value of the awards did not
change. As further required by the 2019 Incentive Plan, the maximum number of shares issuable under the plan was proportionally adjusted,
which resulted in an additional 128,000 RSU shares available to be granted.

The Company's long-term debt consists primarily of Senior Notes, described below. The Company at its option may redeem the Senior Notes at
any time, in whole or in part, at a redemption price plus accrued interest. The redemption price is equal to the greater of 100% of the principal
amount or the sum of the present value of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest to maturity. Additionally, upon certain
events, a holder has the right to require a repurchase at a price of 101% of the principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest. Interest on all
outstanding long-term debt is payable semi-annually. The estimated fair value of Senior Notes is valued using Level 2 inputs.

November 2023, the Company’s Japan subsidiary issued four Guaranteed Senior Notes, totaling approximately $500, at fixed interest rates
ranging from 1.400% to 2.120%. Interest is payable semi-annually, and maturity dates range from November 7, 2033, to November 7, 2043. In

2. **Net Sales:** For fiscal year ended September 1, 2024, net sales were $249,625 million.

Using these figures:

\[ \text{Sales per sq ft} = \frac{\text{Net Sales}}{\text{Total Operating Floor Space (in sq ft)}} \]

\[ \text{Sales per sq ft} = \frac{249,625}{130.9} = 1,897.47 \]

Therefore, the **Sales per sq ft** in 2024 was approximately $1,897.47.
